teaser: What does it mean to be the one everyone assumes will show up? Life path 4 names you a builder, someone who creates order from chaos step by step. ISFJ names a temperament built around care and continuity, the one who notices what needs doing before anyone asks. Crossed, the two don't compete so much as double down: structure wrapped in quiet attention, discipline wrapped in warmth. The risk is that the work absorbs the worker — that the steady hand forgets it has needs of its own, because no one else seems to be asking.
excerpt: The amp that won't stay plugged in gets fixed before rehearsal starts, cable taped down, a backup pedal set within reach, all before anyone else notices there'd been a problem.
